languageEntries.notes: Fluent comprehension, bought - a Wookiee cannot physically speak Basic (Ch3, Wookiees).

row.name: Sharp Claws
row.description: Bony spurs or hardened claws providing enhanced unarmed slashing and impaling damage.

row.name: Fit
row.description: You are unusually robust and healthy, granting bonuses to Endurance Point (EP) recovery and resistance to illness. Ensures you can endure long campaigns, torture, or the rigors of galactic travel, serving any master or cause.

row.name: High Pain Threshold
row.description: You are unusually resistant to the effects of pain, suffering fewer penalties from injury. Allows you to endure torture or continue fighting effectively even when severely wounded, a vital trait for a survivor in a brutal war.

row.name: Combat Reflexes
row.description: You react quickly to threats and keep your composure under pressure. Grants a +1 bonus to active defenses, +2 to Fright Checks, and a +6 bonus to the IQ roll to recover from mental stun (Chapter 9). Those two bonuses are the whole of what steadiness buys: it makes freezing less likely and shorter, and does not make you immune to either. Turn order is unaffected; it is set by Basic Speed and is never rolled for (Chapter 7). Prerequisite: Force Sensitive (if taken as a Force-related advantage, representing a Force-user's enhanced combat intuition).

row.name: Republic Issued Gear
row.description: Republic Trooper Standard Armor (Helmet, Cuirass, Greaves, Gauntlets and Boots) plus a Blaster Rifle. Roughly 5,900 CR of gear.

row.name: Bad Temper
row.description: You are prone to anger and easily provoked, often leading to rash decisions or confrontations.

row.name: Code of Honor (Wookiee)
row.description: Code of Honor (Wookiee) - includes the life debt owed to the human officer who freed him.

row.name: Distinctive Features (8ft tall)
row.description: Immense stature. You stand out in any normal-sized crowd and struggle to use standard-sized facilities.

row.name: Sense of Duty (Party / Friends)
row.description: You feel a strong obligation to a group of friends, or small organization of people.

row.name: Duty (Republic Military)
row.description: You are subject to orders and deployments from the Republic Military. This duty can be highly demanding, placing you in dangerous situations or forcing you to follow directives you might personally disagree with. This strong sense of duty can be exploited by superiors (or even enemies posing as superiors) to manipulate you. Points vary by how often and how stringently the duty applies (e.g., -10 points for frequent, dangerous duty; -15 points for almost continuous dangerous duty).

row.name: Roars when angered
row.description: Frustration or anger comes out as a full-throated Wookiee roar before it comes out as words. Impressive in a fight, inconvenient during negotiations or while hiding.

row.name: Dislikes a specific group
row.description: Trandoshans - his home settlement was razed by Trandoshan slavers.

loadedAmmunitionData.name: Rifle Power Pack
loadedAmmunitionData.notes: A larger, more robust pack used for rifles and carbines. A gas top-up (30 CR) refills it to full; free electric recharging restores the cell only, never spent gas. Bundled with the weapon — its cost and weight are already in the weapon's own figures.
